Manage devices, apps, and security with Intune 

Explore the core capabilities of Microsoft Intune and learn how to manage, secure, and support devices across your organization. 

Device enrollment 

Enroll and prepare devices for management, including Windows Autopilot scenarios. 

Device configuration 

Configure settings and features across managed devices. 

Application management 

Deploy and manage apps across platforms. 

Device updates 

Manage operating system updates across Windows, Apple, and Android devices. 

Device security 

Secure devices using endpoint security policies, security baselines, and Defender integrations in Intune. 

Compliance and access 

Evaluate device compliance in Intune and integrate compliance with Conditional Access to protect access to resources. 

App protection 

Protect corporate data at the app level without requiring device enrollment. 

Copilot and agents 

Use AI-powered assistance and agents to analyze, configure, and manage Intune environments. 

Analytics and reporting 

Monitor device health, compliance, and activity. 

Remote actions and support 

Take actions on devices and help users remotely. 

Administration and governance 

Manage administrative access, roles, scope, and governance features to operate Intune securely and at scale. 

Configuration Manager and co-management 

Manage devices using both cloud and on-premises tools. 

Plan, deploy, and manage Intune 

Learn more about planning your Intune deployment and understanding supported platforms and requirements.
